tool_input.command:
# Clean Python pip cache if it exists
if (Get-Command pip -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
  Write-Host "Cleaning Python pip cache..."
  pip cache purge 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5
  Write-Host ""
}

# Clean VS Code cache (safe - it regenerates)
$vscodeCache = "/home/author\AppData\Local\Programs\Microsoft VS Code"
if (Test-Path $vscodeCache) {
  Write-Host "VS Code takes up $(([math]::Round((Get-ChildItem -Path $vscodeCache -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum / 1GB, 2))) GB"
  Write-Host "VS Code cache can be cleared but will regenerate on next launch"
  Write-Host ""
}

# Show available cleanup options
Write-Host "=== CLEANUP OPTIONS ==="
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "1. SWIFT TOOLCHAIN (4.44 GB) - Remove if not doing iOS/macOS development"
Write-Host "   Remove-Item '/home/author\AppData\Local\Programs\Swift' -Recurse -Force"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "2. ANDROID SDK (4.06 GB) - Remove if not doing Android development"
Write-Host "   Get-ChildItem '/home/author\AppData\Local\Android' -Recurse | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force"
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "3. GOOGLE CHROMIUM VERSIONS (14.8 GB) - Remove if not running browser tests"
Write-Host "   Get-ChildItem '/home/author\AppData\Local\Google' | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force"
Write-Host ""

# Summary
Write-Host "=== SPACE RECLAIMED SO FAR ==="
Write-Host "npm cache: ~209 MB ✓"
